content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Research applies semantic segmentation and classification algorithms to terrestrial and airborne LiDAR point clouds for infrastructure documentation, including multi-class labeling strategies and feature extraction methods.","sources":[{"id":"R0977","field":"keywords","quote":"LiDAR point cloud processing semantic segmentation feature extraction"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-10223","field":"abstract","quote":"Semantic labelling of railway corridor point clouds must distinguish rails sleepers ballast catenary poles"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-00854","field":"abstract","quote":"The pipeline segments ground and above-ground infrastructure classes fits parametric IFC objects"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Work addresses automated processing pipelines that reduce manual operator time for large-scale point cloud datasets, with manual operator time of 11 hours for a test area versus an estimated 140 hours for conventional survey-based modelling.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-00854","field":"abstract","quote":"Manual operator time was 11 hours for the test area versus an estimated 140 hours"},{"id":"R0977","field":"keywords","quote":"scan-to-BIM feature extraction infrastructure documentation"}]},{"claim":3,"text":"Research evaluates trade-offs between different computational approaches for point cloud processing, including comparisons of three feature descriptor strategies and the effect of density normalisation as a preprocessing step on cross-density generalisation.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-10223","field":"abstract","quote":"This study compares three feature descriptor strategies voxel occupancy histograms FPFH descriptors"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-10227","field":"abstract","quote":"The paper also examines the effect of density normalisation as a preprocessing step on cross-density generalisation"}]}]}
